No dividend was disclosed alongside the results per the PSX portal; a Rs 4/share 'estimated annual payout' and an Oct 17 ex-date appear on secondary aggregators but don't trace to a dated primary-source declaration -- treat as unconfirmed, not a basis for a notification. One down year isn't the multi-quarter deterioration bar for an EXIT, so this stays HOLD, but the earnings decline is a genuine negative data point -- watch the next quarter (Q1 FY27) to see if it's a one-off or a trend before adding size. Below both its ~73 entry and ~69 add level.

entries.basis: Monthly-timeframe accumulation zones for a 10-25yr horizon: where fundamentals + monthly support align to add in small portions. 'entry' = start nibbling at/below; 'add' = deeper monthly support to load more. Re-based Oct 2, 2026 against verified PSX Data Portal closes, 50-day/200-day moving averages and 52-week ranges (most names have drifted down since the Sep 1 levels were set, so entries moved down with them) — Pakistan macro-aware (SBP 11.5%, KSE-100 ~11% off the Jan ATH). Re-checked Oct 9, 2026 against fresh 52-week ranges and a self-computed 50-day average from this app's own price history: every level held up except CPHL, which had already fallen through its old add line — see its note. Mutual funds are NAV-based and don't get a level (MIF's old entry was a leftover inconsistency, removed this pass). These are accumulation guides, not precise buy/sell signals — verify with your broker.
